pages.text: Servers can progressively unlock per-operation transfer amounts according to Minecraft advancements completed by the line owner and provide a Sky Logistics advancement tab. No extra mod is required. This feature is disabled by default; enable it at $(thing)transfers.advancements.enabled$().

Each advancementRates entry contains a full advancement ID and optional resource limits. Completed configured advancements unlock the highest value per resource above initialRates; device and other enabled limits still apply. Offline or unknown owners use the initial rates.
